description: Implementation of the UserProfile interface for managing user profile items in a logger system, including methods for checking selections, retrieving data convertors, and building XML profiles.

classes.name: UserProfileImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the UserProfile interface managing user preferences and profile data for ECU logging and diagnostics.

methods.name: UserProfileImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing profile parameters, switches, external data, and protocol.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the logger data is part of the user profile.

methods.name: isSelectedOnLiveDataTab
methods.description: Checks if logger data is selected to be shown on the live data tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnGraphTab
methods.description: Checks if logger data is selected to be shown on the graph tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnDashTab
methods.description: Checks if logger data is selected to be shown on the dashboard tab.

methods.name: getSelectedConvertor
methods.description: Retrieves the data convertor selected for a given logger data, considering default units.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Serializes the user profile XML to a byte array.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the communication protocol used in the profile.

methods.name: buildXml
methods.description: Constructs the profile data as an XML string.

methods.name: appendLoggerDataElements
methods.description: Appends logger data items as XML elements to the profile XML being built.

methods.name: getUserProfileItem
methods.description: Fetches the UserProfileItem for the given LoggerData.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the appropriate map (params, switches, external) based on the type of LoggerData.
